statement: A boat rental building stands on the lake shore a short walk from the shelter; its floor holds swimwear, a cash register, nails, sheets and a stick
Tearing the curtains off the shelter windows yields long strings
A basic fishing rod is crafted in about 5 minutes from 6 long strings, 1 stick and 1 fishing hook
A fishing hook can be crafted from salvaged materials such as nails
Cattail rhizomes and stalks can be harvested by walking through the cattails in the shallows of the lake shore
Raw cattail rhizome gives about 250 kcal, is perishable (about 3 days) and is more nutritious cooked
A protein ration gives about 800 kcal
A hostile zombie was seen about 60 tiles southeast of the lake shore, and a zombie child was spotted again while walking back
A crafting job such as boiling water cannot continue unless a fire stays nearby
The game was saved and quit from inside shelter B-19; the load list shows Morgan Hale in the world Whitethorn

note: checks the inventory showing pocket knife, smartphone, matchbook 19/20 and bottles
goes fishing with a rod at the lake to seek sustainable food
fishes and later harvests cattails on the lake shore west of the shelter
wild boars and piglets close to the route back from the lake
zombie child spotted, auto move canceled, player ignores it and continues
black rats listed near the shelter door while the player lights a fire outside
lights a fire with the matchbook to boil water again
pours boiled clean water into containers after crafting it by the fire
Ava follows and the player opens her interaction menu
opens a shelter locker holding clean water, rations and supplies
